27.2.reason: Observed with Playwright 1.64.1 on darwin-arm64: WebKit 27.2 subtle.sign("Ed25519", key, new Uint8Array()) produces a signature that subtle.verify returns false for. Generated keys and PKCS8/JWK imports have the same outcome; one-byte and 257-byte messages verify true. Local custody refuses its required empty-message key health check as invalid_key.

Observed with Playwright 1.64.1 on linux-x64: WebKit 27.2 importKey("pkcs8") rejects every Ed25519 private key whose 32-byte seed begins with 0x00 (DataError; 100 of 100 controlled seeds, all 25 failures among 5,000 random keys). JWK import of the same keys succeeds. Local custody refuses the PKCS8 form as invalid_key.

Observed with Playwright 1.64.1 on linux-x64: WebKit 27.2's libgcrypt backend calls mpiData(valueSexp) in CryptoAlgorithmRSA_OAEPGCrypt.cpp gcryptDecrypt (line 109, revision aa697ddd0312b191de5fb13b580f19159d39c26f). GCryptUtilities.cpp mpiData (line 133) prints the recovered message as a minimal unsigned MPI, dropping every leading 0x00 octet. RSA-OAEP and RSA-OAEP-256 decrypt or unwrapKey therefore shorten leading-zero A128GCM/A256GCM CEKs, and JWE decryption returns decryption_failed. The encrypt side is unaffected: gcryptEncrypt uses mpiZeroPrefixedData(aSexp, keySizeInBytes) at line 72.

WebKit 27.2 through Playwright 1.64.1 reports Fetch access-control diagnostics as pageerror for the real closed-loopback-port and reserved .invalid probes, although their fetch failures are handled. The harness requires both exact probe diagnostics and corresponding requestfailed events, records this observation once, and treats every other page error as fatal. Library results remain bounded and classify as unknown.
